Status box

Source: R/status.R
kit_status_ui.Rd

Renders a kit_status() as a status box: the first line is the label plus a one-sentence conclusion; then up to 3 points (things to watch out for first, key results after), the rest collapsed under "還有 N 點" ("N more points"); a button for what to do; small additional notes; the collapsed raw message. After running, use kit_scroll_to() to scroll it to the top of the screen.

Usage

kit_status_ui(st, ..., max_points = KIT_STATUS_MAX_POINTS)

Arguments

st

A kit_status() object (a list with the same fields, from older apps, also works); NULL or "idle" shows nothing.

...

Other content placed last inside the box (kitsUI's ui_status(...)).

max_points

How many points to list directly (default 3).

Value

<div class="alert alert-success kit-status" role="alert"> or similar; NULL when nothing is shown.

Details

A kit_status object can also go straight into the page (its htmltools::as.tags() method is this function); you only need to call this function to add more content or change the number of points.

Examples

kit_status_ui(kit_done_status(
  "串接完成：結果共 3,389 列 × 2,058 欄。",
  warnings = c("有 12 人的 ID 重複。", "第 3 波沒有 sex 欄。"),
  points = c("688 人每個檔案都有資料。", "第 1 波 3,389 人。")
))
#> <div class="alert alert-warning kit-status" role="alert">
#>   <div class="kit-status-line">
#>     <strong>【完成，但請注意】</strong>
#>      
#>     串接完成：結果共 3,389 列 × 2,058 欄。
#>   </div>
#>   <ul>
#>     <li>有 12 人的 ID 重複。</li>
#>     <li>第 3 波沒有 sex 欄。</li>
#>     <li>688 人每個檔案都有資料。</li>
#>   </ul>
#>   <details class="kit-status-more">
#>     <summary>還有 1 點</summary>
#>     <ul>
#>       <li>第 1 波 3,389 人。</li>
#>     </ul>
#>   </details>
#> </div>
